title: Finished tasks are graph memory: .hunch/tasks/ records written through the normal capture path, ledger stays local
context: Task reports lived only in the machine-local observation ledger (.hunch-cache/served.db, 90-day retention) plus generated HTML. David (2026-09-14): tasks performed are something Hunch needs to know about; they should be saved in the repo automatically like decisions, in Hunch's JSON record format, respecting the private/public routing, as part of the engine and visible in the extension.
decision: Add a 'tasks' entity kind (TaskRecordSchema in src/core/types.ts, id htask_*). On every finish (CLI `hunch task finish`, MCP hunch_task, engine createTaskReporter().finish) a task with at least one observation is summarized (title, delivered lesson revisions, agent-reported applications with rule support, saves with home+durability, checks, latest conformance per record, refusal count, touched files, source snapshot, report content hash) and written via HunchStore.putCapture + flushCapture — the same path as decisions/findings — so homing, the one-home-per-record rule, auto-commit and team routing are identical. Home rule: store.captureHome first (unified mode), then private if any save went private or a delivered lesson exists only in the overlay; a record's home never changes after the first write. Empty tasks stay ledger-only. Idempotent on report_hash. Failure to persist is disclosed on the card and never blocks finish. Tasks are FTS-indexed, HunchStore.tasksFor(file) feeds a RECENT TASKS section in hunch_why, `hunch task list` merges graph records into the ledger view (durable: {home}) including graph-only tasks, `hunch report <id>` falls back to the graph record, and the VS Code Contribution view shows 'in graph (home)' and opens the record for graph-only tasks. `taskRecords: false` in .hunch/local.json opts out.
consequences: Each finished task with observations produces a `hunch: task <id>` capture commit in the repo (or the overlay) when auto-commit is on.
Additive kind: older graphs load unchanged; older readers ignore .hunch/tasks/ (state-kinds test updated to slice(9, 15)).
The prompt-hook/MCP drive-letter casing bug (fnd_99da2635c3) is fixed in the same change via canonicalReportRoot (realpathSync.native) with a legacy scope fallback.
alternatives_rejected: Commit the raw observation ledger or full report JSON: contains private context payloads, denial reasons and per-event prose; retention and privacy contracts in docs/task-reports.md forbid it.
Persist every task including empty ones: one auto-commit per bare prompt is commit noise, not memory; empty rows remain countable in the local ledger.
A separate tasks store/table outside the entity kinds: would bypass captureHome/putCapture and create a second routing rule for public vs private.
